# Leveled bid comparison: Bid package 07A roofing

**Low bidder:** Blue Heron Roofing & Sheet Metal LLC at $571,900.

Three bids were received for the 07A roofing package. They are ranked below
by the base bid each bidder submitted.

## Summary

| Rank | Bidder | Base bid | Documents |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Blue Heron Roofing & Sheet Metal LLC | $571,900 | blue-heron-quote.eml |
| 2 | Cardinal Commercial Roofing Co. | $598,750 | cardinal-bid-form.xlsx, cardinal-cover-email.eml |
| 3 | Ironwood Roofing Systems, Inc. | $612,400 | ironwood-proposal.pdf |

The spread between the low bid and the high bid is $40,500, about 7 percent.
